_readme: Office Action Studio — jurisdiction profile template.
This block goes inside a country profile JSON as the top-level key 'officeActionProfile'
Canonical objection codes: NOVELTY, INVENTIVE_STEP, ELIGIBILITY, CLARITY, SUFFICIENCY,
UNITY, ADDED_MATTER, DOUBLE_PATENTING, PROCEDURAL_DISCLOSURE, FORMALITIES, OTHER.
Periods are ISO-8601 subsets: P6M, P15D, P2Y. Prosecution models: PER_REPORT
HYBRID (UK per-report clocks inside a compliance ceiling).
Reference implementation: Countries/IN.json. Facts per office: OFFICE_ACTION_WESTERN_JURISDICTIONS.md.

meta.lawVersion: Governing act + rules edition this profile encodes

detectionHints: LITERAL PHRASES that identify this document type in uploads
